name: Moonfin-Beta
overview: Custom UI and settings sync for Jellyfin
description:
Moonfin brings a modern TV-style UI to Jellyfin web. Features include: custom navbar, media bar with featured content, Jellyseerr integration, and cross-device settings synchronization. Works with Android TV, Roku, Tizen, webOS, and Web clients.

Requires File Transformation plugin for automatic UI injection.

versions.changelog:
Moonbase 2.3.0 adds the backend for anime markers, scores recommendations on the server, and keeps a backup of its settings with a restore button. It fixes message text that could wipe every plugin setting on a restart, gets the scheduled tasks running on their own again on Jellyfin 10.11 and 12, and bundles the Moonfin 2.6.0 web app.

Features:

- Anime markers flag filler, mixed, canon and recap episodes using the Anime Filler List and Tenrai, and mark Subbed or Dubbed from the audio in your own files. It's off by default, under Integrations.
- Recommendations are scored on the server. On Jellyfin 12 that scoring plugs into Jellyfin's own similar items so every client gets it, and a switch under Integrations hands it back to Jellyfin.
- Moonbase keeps a backup of its server settings and offers to restore it if they ever come back reset.
- Clients can show when a series airs next through the server, even without Sonarr.
- Admin defaults for the metadata row, the loading animation, the screensaver, the new detail screen styles, Seerr missing collection items and availability badges, the Downloads and Live TV buttons, the Rate action button, fallback audio and subtitle languages, and the Grandparents interface size.
- The bundled web app moves up to Moonfin 2.6.0, with the Spotlight, Nouveau and Minimalist detail screens, Kids Mode, Achievement Badges, a redone Live TV guide, and fonts that no longer load from Google.

Bug Fixes:

- Message text can no longer corrupt the settings file, which Jellyfin answered by resetting every setting and sometimes removing the plugin on the next start.
- Applying defaults only changes what the admin actually set.
- Scheduled tasks run on their own on Jellyfin 10.11 and 12, and custom home rows now refresh daily.
- Notifications, the media bar and genre lists stop showing items a user isn't allowed to see.
- Hidden Continue Watching and Next Up items stay hidden on every device.
- Retro game artwork is far more reliable on large libraries, and PSP games can start in Moonfin Web once the new isolation checkbox under Retro Games is on.
- The Moonfin header button shows in the Jellyfin 12 web UI.
